label: Phase 2 repair models.py missing LeaveCalendar, LeavePolicyParameter, and LeaveApplication timestamps
instruction: Fix modules/leave_elm/models.py where several fields and the last two model classes were accidentally omitted: (1) On LeaveApplication, keep all existing fields AND restore `approved_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)`, `cancelled_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)`, `extension_requested = models.BooleanField(default=False)`, `extension_approved = models.BooleanField(default=False)`, `extension_start_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)`, `extension_end_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)`, and `extension_approved_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)`, and rename `fitness_certificate_Reference` to lowercase `fitness_certificate_reference`. (2) At the bottom of the file, after LeaveResumption, restore `LeavePolicyParameter(TimeStampedModel, UserScopedModel)` with `name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True)` and `value = models.JSONField(default=dict)`, and `LeaveCalendar(TimeStampedModel, UserScopedModel)` with `name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True)` and `holidays = models.JSONField(default=list)`. Keep all other model classes and fields unchanged. Return the complete valid Python file.
